definitions.gloss: checkroom; left-luggage office; storage counter; deposit place
definitions.explanation: A place where items — typically luggage, bags, or valuables — can be temporarily stored or checked. Found at train stations, airports, theaters, amusement parks, and other public facilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧{預|あず}かり{所|じょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦スーツケース→スーツケース：01781_suutsukeesu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{預|あず}かり{所|じょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}けた→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧。
examples.english: I left my suitcase at the storage counter.
The station's luggage storage can be used from 8 AM to 8 PM.

examples.japanese: ⟦コインロッカー→コインロッカー：30576_koinrokkaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いていなかった→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{手荷物|てにもつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧{預|あず}かり{所|じょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}した→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Since the coin lockers were all full, I used the luggage storage counter.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{預|あず}かり→預かる：01817_azukaru⟧ (keeping, custody — from ⟦{預|あず}かる→預かる：01817_azukaru⟧, to take custody of) and {所|じょ} (place, office). This is a practical travel and daily-life term that visitors to Japan will encounter at stations and tourist destinations.

While coin lockers are ubiquitous at Japanese train stations, staffed {預|あず}かり{所|じょ} counters handle oversized luggage and offer longer storage periods. Tourist-oriented luggage storage services have also become common in major cities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧{預|あず}かり{所|じょ}: luggage storage
- ⟦{手荷物|てにもつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧{預|あず}かり{所|じょ}: baggage checkroom
- ⟦{貴重品|きちょうひん}→貴重品：15344_kichouhin⟧{預|あず}かり{所|じょ}: valuables storage
- {預|あず}かり{所|じょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧: to leave at the storage counter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦コインロッカー→コインロッカー：30576_koinrokkaa⟧: coin locker — self-service lockers at stations; no staff interaction needed
- {保管所|ほかんじょ}: storage facility — for longer-term safekeeping of goods or documents
- クローク: cloakroom — at hotels, theaters, or event venues, for coats and bags
